item.title: Hakata Ramen School: Make Your Own Ramen — Guide
item.description: For ramen lovers, a Hakata ramen-making class is a fun, hands-on way to get behind the counter of Fukuoka’s most famous dish. Guided by instructors, hands-on experiences let you learn the secrets of tonkotsu ramen — understanding the rich pork-bone broth, preparing the thin Hakata-style noodles, assembling the toppings, and finally cooking and eating a bowl of ramen you made yourself. Some classes are aimed at serious enthusiasts wanting to learn techniques in depth, others are casual, family-friendly experiences; either way you come away with real insight into what makes Hakata ramen special, and the satisfaction of eating your own creation.
